name: The Al-Hassan house

style: Contemporary coastal (modern farmhouse) with an attached garage
materials: black-framed tall windows with thin white flat casings

notes: Main block 12.6 x 9.2 m, 35 deg side gable, roof surface 6.45 m at the walls, ridge 9.7 m (Atlas height 7.5 m; within the 30% allowance), with a steeper (44 deg) front cross gable over the entry holding three tall black-framed windows and a clerestory. All of it is interpreted from the brief (no reference photo): deep full-width front porch with a standing-seam shed roof, cedar posts and black picket rail; screened porch at the back right under its own gable; attached two-car garage on the left; concrete drive and paver walk both meet the curb line; beds with hydrangeas and ornamental grasses; one multi-stem river birch. No fence or hedge on the frontage.
